parole.testo: From Louisiana Creole craps, a corruption of English crabs.

parole.testo: 1886, originally for a five-cent US coin (a nickel); use for taxis and buses due to these services originally charging five cents as fare, popularized circa 1915. parole.significato: Synonym of okra: the plant or its edible capsules.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Louisiana French gombo, possibly via Louisiana Creole gombo, from Kimbundu ingombo, plural of kingombo (“okra”); compare Portuguese quingombó.
